run_generate_copt_file: run the script to generate Abseil compile option config files for CMake and Starlark
create_cmake_style_copt: create a CMake-style copt file with list(APPEND) syntax from COPT_VARS
create_starlark_style_copt: create a Starlark-style copt file with list assignment syntax from COPT_VARS
build_copt_list: build a formatted copt list string for a given variable name and argument list using a style object
summarize_main_entry_point: summarize the main entry point that generates both Starlark and CMake copt output files
